description: This file defines the EventHubQueueCacheFactory class, which implements the IEventHubQueueCacheFactory interface. It is responsible for creating and configuring instances of IEventHubQueueCache, including setting up buffer pools, cache pressure monitors, and cache eviction strategies for Event Hub streaming in Orleans.

classes.name: EventHubQueueCacheFactory
classes.description: Factory class to configure and create IEventHubQueueCache instances for Event Hubs streaming, managing buffer pools, cache pressure, and eviction strategies.

methods.name: CreateCache
methods.description: Creates an IEventHubQueueCache instance with configured buffer pool, cache pressure monitors, and eviction strategy for a specific partition.

methods.name: CreateBufferPool
methods.description: Configures and returns a buffer pool for the EventHubQueueCache, which can be overridden for customization.

methods.name: AddCachePressureMonitors
methods.description: Adds cache pressure monitors to the cache, customizable by overriding.

methods.name: CreateCache
methods.description: Default method to instantiate an EventHubQueueCache with specified parameters, can be overridden for customization.
